I ran all 14 queries against the input files and each one returned a sensible answer. I checked T4, T11 and T12 by hand.

One thing to know about T10: with `--raw`, the keys print as keywords (`:db 3`), because every key of a qlang map is a keyword. I left it that way.

Queries that begin with `/` need `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1` in front when run in Git Bash. The T10–T13 queries need `--raw` because their inputs are text files.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com") | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) | * /name
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") * count
T4: /data/users * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (/labels * (/name | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | if (eq null) ~(null) ~(/login))}
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) * count
T8: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | unionOf /0 /1 | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | * (:e / | /0 | keyword | append "@" | append (e | /1))
T9: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | filter ~(/port | gt 8000) | * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | * split " " | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) * count
T11: lines | * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=") | first) | filter ~(ne null) | * (drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * split "," | filter ~(/5 | lower | eq "shipped") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | * (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * split "," | filter ~(/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1) * (* (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2) | entries | * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total /1} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
T14: ["Banana" "apple" "Cherry" "banana" "fig" "APPLE" "date" "kiwi" "Fig" "elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) (/)]) | join "-"
